caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sideboard or cabinet with a light brown finish and visible wood grain patterns. The piece of furniture features a single wide drawer at the top with two round wooden knobs, one on each side. Below the drawer, there are two cabinet doors, each with an inset panel that has an arched design at the top. The space between the cabinet doors is open and arch-shaped, creating a niche that extends from the bottom to just below the drawer. The sideboard stands on four short legs with decorative cut-outs at the bottom and small caster wheels attached to each leg. The background of the drawing is plain, and there is a signature reading "Stewart" in the lower right corner of the image. The lines and shading indicate the contours and depth of the furniture, contributing to a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Knee-hole Desk
